articles.title: Metaplanet buys Siiibo Securities to accelerate bitcoin financial ecosystem plans
articles.snippet: The approximately $13.1 million acquisition gives Metaplanet a regulated securities platform to develop Bitcoin-linked investment products.

articles.title: There's one simple way to tell whether bitcoin has really bottomed. Right now, it hasn't.
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's weekly RSI contains a critical level that has reliably separated bull and bear market regimes across multiple cycles. Right now, the indicator has yet to clear that line.

articles.title: Iran-Linked Group That Hacked Kash Patel's Email Threatens World Cup With Hijacked FBI Drones
articles.snippet: The Iran-linked hacking group said it accessed footage from FBI-controlled drones and warned World Cup teams that they could be targeted.
